title: Pip and the Little Frog
note: b412 — wordless Phase 1 book. No text is ever painted into these pages; briefs give the ComfyUI pipeline who, what and where for each page.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow flying low over a green pond, looking down at something moving in the reeds at the water's edge.
A small green froglet tangled in strands of pale green pondweed at the water's edge, eyes wide, struggling.
Pip the sparrow landed beside the tangled froglet, head tilted, working out how to help.
Pip the sparrow tugging a strand of pale green pondweed loose with his beak while the froglet watches.
A small green froglet, now free of the weeds, hopping onto a round lily pad.
Pip the sparrow and a small green froglet sitting together on a lily pad in warm sunshine, both relaxed and happy.
